name: Estelle Ceulemans - § 17 - Am 6
title: REPORT with recommendations to the Commission on psychosocial risk, stress and mental health at work
part_text: 17. Stresses the importance of preventing work-related psychosocial risks, including those associated with the use of digital and algorithmic management tools; considers that Member States and social partners are best placed to determine appropriate measures in accordance with national circumstances; stresses that action at European level should respect the principles of subsidiarity and proportionality and avoid disproportionate burdens, in particular on SMEs and micro-enterprises;
